{"command":"create","path":"/workspace/terminate_updates.sh","file_text":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Kill likely "system update" daemons by process name (not args) to avoid false positives
regex='^(apt|apt-get|aptitude|dpkg|unattended-.*|packagekitd|pkcon|snapd|yum|dnf|zypper|pacman(|-mirrors)|update(-.*)?|apt\.systemd\.daily)$'

pids_to_kill=()

for piddir in /proc/[0-9]*; do
  pid=${piddir#/proc/}
  [[ -r "$piddir/comm" ]] || continue
  comm=$(tr -d '\n' < "$piddir/comm" || true)
  [[ -n "$comm" ]] || continue
  if [[ "$comm" =~ $regex ]]; then
    pids_to_kill+=("$pid")
  fi
done

if ((${#pids_to_kill[@]}==0)); then
  echo "No update-related processes found."
else
  echo "Found update-related PIDs: ${pids_to_kill[*]}"
  kill -TERM "${pids_to_kill[@]}" 2>/dev/null || true

  end=$((SECONDS+5))
  while ((${#pids_to_kill[@]}>0)) && ((SECONDS<end)); do
    alive=()
    for pid in "${pids_to_kill[@]}"; do
      if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        alive+=("$pid")
      fi
    done
    pids_to_kill=("${alive[@]:-}")
    sleep 0.5
  done

  if ((${#pids_to_kill[@]}>0)); then
    echo "Forcing remaining PIDs: ${pids_to_kill[*]}"
    kill -KILL "${pids_to_kill[@]}" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
fi

# Additionally attempt to stop related services if systemctl is available
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for svc in apt-daily apt-daily-upgrade unattended-upgrades packagekit snapd; do
    systemctl stop "$svc".service 2>/dev/null || true
    systemctl stop "$svc".timer 2>/dev/null || true
  done
fi

echo "Done."
"}
